@yun520-1/deepseek-heartflow.target: HeartFlow, a rule-only discrimination gate: 47 dimensions across heartflow_check, analyze, verdict, and dimensions, with supervision emitted automatically after each tool call. Fail-closed, and no LLM involved.

@rongyi7/dsh-stats.source: 工作区 Token 消耗统计 + 开发时间线 + 消费金额（DSH 插件：Tier 2 宿主 RPC + 客户端 UI）
@rongyi7/dsh-stats.target: Per-workspace token consumption, a development timeline, and spend — a host RPC service with its own client UI.

dsh-assistant-message-forge.source: DSH 助手消息锻造台：可创建/修改/注入测试用 assistant 消息，并可导入识别 session.jsonl(.zstd) 会话日志。

dsh-theme-center.target: A curated theme gallery for the dsh web UI, grouped light and dark, with one-click switching, custom wallpaper, and dsh-theme import and export.

dsh-vision-fallback.target: Silent vision fallback: you keep choosing the main model, images are quietly routed to a fixed vision model, and the description comes back as hidden context.

@dsh-suite/plugin-manager.target: A plugin store for the DSH web UI — catalogue browsing, search, one-click install, compatibility badges, and an installed list.

dsh-im-wecom.source: 企业微信 渠道适配器（dsh-im 插件家族）。
dsh-im-wecom.target: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) channel adapter for the dsh-im family.

It also registers read_image_free, which calls Zhipu GLM-4.1V-Thinking-Flash for OCR and image understanding, so the model handles pictures without needing the skill.

dsh-tool-reqpipe.source: DeepSeek Harness 插件：reqpipe 研发需求流水线管理工具（需求→方案→评审→开发），含 create/advance/skip/list/show/checklist 工具
dsh-tool-reqpipe.target: reqpipe, a requirements pipeline for development work — requirement to proposal to review to build — with create, advance, skip, list, show, and checklist tools.

dsh-weixin.target: A WeChat (iLink) channel that feeds WeChat messages into dsh sessions, isolated per user, injected natively and replied to in place.

dsh-recommend.target: Transparent plugin ranking and recommendation: crawls the dsh-plugin topic ecosystem daily, scores it with a published model, and exposes rank, recommend, and search tools plus a leaderboard tab in settings.

dsh-codegraph.target: Ports lazycodex's CodeGraph context injection to dsh: exposes codegraph_explore to the model over an MCP bridge, runs codegraph init at session start to seed the index, and injects setup guidance when a tool result reports the index is missing.

dsh-llm-codex-subscription.target: Reuses the Codex CLI's local credentials (~/.codex/auth.json) so you can drive ChatGPT subscription models from dsh.

dsh-notifier.target: One notify() call, many destinations: adapters for Telegram, DingTalk, Feishu, WxPusher, PushPlus, ServerChan, Bark, and plain webhooks, driven either by session events or by the agent calling a tool, both sharing one adapter registry. dsh-tool-memory.target: Hermes-style persistent memory across sessions: plain-text MEMORY.md and USER.md, a frozen snapshot injected into the system prompt, and memory_* tools for add, replace, remove, batch, show, and refresh.

dsh-session-management.target: Session management for the DSH web UI: archive, unarchive, permanently delete chats, and export your data. Bilingual.

deepseek-harness-zh_pro.target: Chinese localisation polish, active only in the Chinese UI: fixes leftover English, unifies terminology and formatting, and keeps status lines fully visible instead of truncated.

dsh-skin-switcher.target: Lists your installed skins in Settings with a one-click switch. Switching writes a managed section in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, which the dsh config watcher hot-reloads — no server restart.

@feiyang666/deepseekharnessdesktop-vault.source: 数据保险箱：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供备份、清空检测与一键恢复。备份触发时机：启动备份、意外关闭备份、手动备份（不再按会话落盘或定时全量备份，避免大量任务运行时卡死）。自动备份 ~/.dsh 的聊天记录(sessions)、工作区数据(storages)、设置(settings.yaml)、凭据与 profile 配置到用户主目录 ~/.dsh-backups（最多保留 10 份），检测数据被清空并支持按范围恢复与删除备份。设置页提供「备份管理」界面（Host+Client 双面插件）。

It captures sessions, workspace storages, settings.yaml, credentials, and profile config from ~/.dsh into ~/.dsh-backups, keeping the last ten, and detects a wiped install so you can restore selectively or delete old backups. @qing3a/dsh-tray.source: Windows 系统托盘插件：托盘图标 + 菜单（打开界面/状态/退出）+ 气泡通知，基于 trayicon（exe 宿主，无 native 编译）
@qing3a/dsh-tray.target: A Windows system tray icon with a menu — open, status, quit — and balloon notifications, built on trayicon so there is no native compilation.

dsh-lan-pass.source: DSH 局域网密码门禁：手机/平板输密钥直连 3080，内置 randomUUID polyfill 与移动端登录页。
dsh-lan-pass.target: Password-gates dsh on your local network so a phone or tablet can reach port 3080 directly. Ships a randomUUID polyfill and a mobile login page.

@dsh-market/plugin.source: DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core
@dsh-market/plugin.target: The DSH Market client: a sidebar for browsing, searching, recommendations, one-click install, and managing what you have installed. Core logic lives in @dsh-market/core.

@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy.source: DSH web 插件：在「Deep diving...」状态前插入一个动态小表情 —— GrokBot 风格动画头像（纯 SVG + rAF，移植自 nasawz/GrokBot，无任何运行时依赖），也可切换为 emoji 轮播模式
@dsh-plugin/dsh-thought-buddy.target: Puts a small animated face in front of the "Deep diving…" state — a GrokBot-style avatar in pure SVG and rAF, ported from nasawz/GrokBot with no runtime dependencies, or an emoji carousel instead.

@dsh-suite/preset-center.source: 中文开箱即用预设全家桶：小红书笔记助手 / 中文文案润色 / 日报周报生成器，一键应用到官方 Agent presets / Out-of-the-box Chinese agent presets: Xiaohongshu notes, copy polishing, daily/weekly reports.
@dsh-suite/preset-center.target: Ready-made Chinese agent presets applied to the official set in one click: a Xiaohongshu notes assistant, a copy-polishing preset, and a daily and weekly report generator.

@dsh-suite/themes.source: 151 款 AionUi 皮肤聚合 + 皮肤中心试穿面板 / A 151-skin pack with a try-on panel for DSH Web UI.
@dsh-suite/themes.target: 151 AionUi skins with a try-on panel for the DSH web UI.

dsh-claude-migrator.source: Claude → DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 配置迁移插件：把 .claude/skills、.claude/rules、.mcp.json、CLAUDE.md 拖入插件目录即自动加载为 DSH 能力，内置完整看板（skills / rules / MCP / 连接状态）。
dsh-claude-migrator.target: Migrates a Claude setup to dsh: drop .claude/skills, .claude/rules, .mcp.json, and CLAUDE.md into the plugin directory and they load as dsh capabilities, with a dashboard covering skills, rules, MCP servers, and connection status.

dsh-cost-balance.source: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的 iOS 风格统计条：一键展开查看会话花费、账户余额、缓存命中与 Token 用量。
dsh-cost-balance.target: An iOS-style stat bar under the composer: expand it for session spend, account balance, cache hits, and token usage.

dsh-drop-in.source: 鎷栧叆鏂囦欢锛氳緭鍏ユ涓婃柟鏂囦欢鏍?+ 闅忔秷鎭彂閫侊紙鍚粷瀵硅矾寰勶級+ 姘旀场鏂囦欢鍗＄墖銆侱rag files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message (absolute paths included).
dsh-drop-in.target: Drag files into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI and send them with your message, absolute paths included.

dsh-guard.source: DSH 运行期守护：启动成功后自动存档；插件加载失败时自动回退到上次良好快照并重启。
dsh-guard.target: Runtime guard: snapshots a good configuration once startup succeeds, and if a plugin later fails to load it rolls back to the last good snapshot and restarts.

dsh-opencode-usage.source: OpenCode Go 订阅用量监控：侧边栏底部常驻徽标（5h/周/月百分比，异常标红），点击在左侧弹出详情卡片（重置倒计时、趋势、告警、Key 配置），用量突增/超标标红提醒（防额度被他人盗刷）。
dsh-opencode-usage.target: Monitors OpenCode Go subscription usage from a badge pinned at the bottom of the sidebar — five-hour, weekly, and monthly percentages, turning red on anomalies. Click for a detail card with reset countdowns, trends, alerts, and key configuration; sudden spikes or overruns are flagged so a stolen key does not go unnoticed.

dsh-shield.source: 脱手模式安全网：删除目录先进回收站、删除链接绝不跟随。零审批、零弹窗。
dsh-shield.target: A safety net for hands-off runs: directory deletions go to the trash first, and deletions never follow symlinks. No approvals, no dialogs.

dsh-skin-dark-gold.source: Dark-gold particle skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 暗金背景 + 漂浮金色粒子 + 暖白黄文字
dsh-skin-dark-gold.target: A dark-gold particle skin for the dsh web GUI: a dark gold ground, drifting gold particles, and warm off-white type.

dsh-stock-watch.source: A股自选股实时行情盯盘插件 - DeepSeek Harness Web 右上角可折叠弹窗（分时/K线/目标价/主题切换/可拖动/添加股票分组）
dsh-stock-watch.target: A collapsible A-share watchlist in the top right of the dsh web UI, with intraday and candlestick charts, target prices, theme switching, dragging, and grouped tickers.

dsh-themes.source: DSH 外观与主题插件:内置调色板、Open VSX 搜索导入、颜色参数编辑器、明暗独立归属
dsh-themes.target: Appearance and theming: a built-in palette, search and import from Open VSX, a colour parameter editor, and independent light and dark assignments.

dsh-vision-tools.source: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图
dsh-vision-tools.target: A full vision kit: the vision_understand tool against any OpenAI-compatible vision API, defaulting to the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash, plus three ways in — paste, drag, or a button.

dsh-wallpaper-rotator.source: DSH 壁纸轮换插件：定时轮换应用背景壁纸（交叉淡化动效），内置 SVG 壁纸集，毛玻璃/压暗/文字阴影/背景不透明度等可读性调节，设置页可配置。
dsh-wallpaper-rotator.target: Rotates the app wallpaper on a timer with a cross-fade, ships an SVG wallpaper set, and exposes readability controls — frosted glass, dimming, text shadow, and background opacity — from a settings page.

dsh-wx-skin.source: DSH Web GUI 皮肤插件：侧栏「皮肤」面板，支持自选本地图片 / URL 作为全屏背景，含预设、暗化、模糊、关闭皮肤，跨刷新持久化（外部 client 插件，dsh-web-ui 风格）。
dsh-wx-skin.target: A Skins panel in the sidebar that takes a local image or a URL as a full-screen background, with presets, dimming, blur, and an off switch, persisted across reloads.

launch-panel.source: DSH Web GUI 右侧的火箭发射任务面板：近一月发射汇总 + 悬停详情，可折叠为左箭头
launch-panel.target: A rocket-launch mission panel on the right of the web GUI: the last month of launches summarised, details on hover, collapsible to an arrow.

@wangjiezhong/dsh-memory.source: 跨会话记忆系统 —— 让 AI Agent 记住你的项目上下文、决策和偏好
@wangjiezhong/dsh-memory.target: Cross-session memory that lets the agent remember your project context, decisions, and preferences.

@wangjiezhong/dsh-moat.source: 代码质量门禁 —— 智能检查代码语法、启动链、API 和跨系统关联
@wangjiezhong/dsh-moat.target: A code quality gate that checks syntax, startup paths, APIs, and cross-system dependencies.

dsh-a-stock-select.source: A股选股与持仓诊断 DSH 插件：四大策略（超短线/短线/中线/长线）+ 持仓诊断，基于 a-stock-data 开发，内置 47 个数据端点，输出强制风险提示
dsh-a-stock-select.target: A-share stock selection and portfolio diagnosis across four strategies — ultra-short, short, medium, and long term — built on a-stock-data with 47 data endpoints. Every answer carries a mandatory risk disclaimer.

dsh-approval-gate.source: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 模型预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全自动批准、危险转人工（fail-safe）
dsh-approval-gate.target: Automatic approval gating: a Flash model predicts whether a write or command is irreversible, auto-approving what is safe and escalating what is not. Fail-safe by design.

dsh-think-chinese.source: DSH 插件：让模型始终用中文进行内部推理与思考（think in Chinese）。
dsh-think-chinese.target: Makes the model do its internal reasoning in Chinese.

dsh-vision-adapter.source: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加视觉能力：为 Kimi/智谱/千问/OpenAI/Gemini/豆包 等各起一个进程内视觉桥，接口已预设，设置页只需填 API Key。
dsh-vision-adapter.target: Adds vision to dsh by starting an in-process bridge for each provider — Kimi, Zhipu, Qwen, OpenAI, Gemini, Doubao. The endpoints are preconfigured; you only supply an API key in settings.

dsh-plugin-commands.source: DSH 通用斜杠命令加载器插件：扫描项目 .agents/commands/*.md 与 .dsh/commands/*.md，注册为 opencode 风格的 / 斜杠命令
dsh-plugin-commands.target: A general slash-command loader: scans .agents/commands/*.md and .dsh/commands/*.md in your project and registers them as opencode-style slash commands.

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-d399.source: 贪玩蓝鲸 — 模型生成时右下角弹出小游戏菜单（wordle / 消消乐，可拓展游戏注册表）
@huanlin/dsh-plugin-d399.target: Something to do while the model thinks: a small game menu pops up in the bottom right during generation — Wordle and a match-three, with an extensible game registry.

dsh-auth-plugin.source: DSH Web 用户授权插件 — 用户名密码 + 通用 OAuth 2.0（内置 GitHub/Google/Discord 等模板）+ Solana/EVM 钱包登录。零依赖核心，纯配置接入
dsh-auth-plugin.target: User authentication for the dsh web UI: username and password, generic OAuth 2.0 with templates for GitHub, Google, and Discord, and Solana or EVM wallet login. A zero-dependency core wired entirely through configuration.

dsh-tdai-memory.source: DeepSeek Harness 的 TencentDB Agent Memory 移植：L0 对话捕获 → L1 结构化记忆提取 → L2 场景/L3 画像，自动召回注入 + 记忆/对话搜索工具；复用现有 ~/.memory-tencentdb/memory-tdai 数据；附 Web UI 设置栏。
dsh-tdai-memory.target: A port of TencentDB Agent Memory: conversations captured at L0, structured memories extracted at L1, then scenes at L2 and a profile at L3, recalled and injected automatically, with memory and conversation search tools. Reuses existing ~/.memory-tencentdb/memory-tdai data and adds a settings panel.

dsh-tool-vision.source: DeepSeek Harness 外置视觉模型插件：inspect_image 把本地图片或 http(s) 图片 URL 发给任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，视觉模型看图的文字回答直接带回对话；附 Web UI 设置栏。
dsh-tool-vision.target: inspect_image sends a local file or an http(s) image URL to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and brings the vision model's written answer straight back into the conversation. Adds a settings panel.

dsh-yolo-mode.source: dsh-yolo-mode —— DeepSeek Harness 双面包插件：当会话处于可写沙箱模式且审批策略为 ask 时，用大模型自动裁决沙箱升权申请，支持内置预设与自定义权限层级，并提供宿主 settings + 自发布设置桥（/yolo-mode）与 Web 客户端 UI。
dsh-yolo-mode.target: When a session is in a writable sandbox and the approval policy is set to ask, a model adjudicates sandbox escalation requests instead of you. Built-in presets and custom permission tiers, with host settings, a self-published settings bridge (/yolo-mode), and a web client UI.

dsh-ergonomics.source: DSH 会话人体工学：/new 一键新会话 + 输入历史 ↑↓ 回溯 + Ctrl+C 终止会话
dsh-ergonomics.target: Session ergonomics: /new for a fresh session, ↑↓ through your input history, and Ctrl+C to stop a session.

dsh-plugin-marketplace.source: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 内置插件市场：在设置页直接浏览 github.com/topics/dsh-plugin，支持搜索、按 Star 排序、查看安装方式。
dsh-plugin-marketplace.target: A plugin marketplace inside the web UI: browse github.com/topics/dsh-plugin from the settings page, search it, sort by stars, and see how to install each one.

dsh-soul-md.source: DeepSeek Harness 的 soul.md 风格人设卡插件：把 markdown 人设文件注入系统提示词（soul:persona），文件变更热重载，让 Agent 边干活边角色扮演；附 Web UI 设置栏。
dsh-soul-md.target: soul.md-style persona cards: injects a markdown persona file into the system prompt as soul:persona and hot-reloads it on change, so the agent stays in character while it works. Adds a settings panel.

@dsh-ltctfer/dsh-opencode-go-usage.source: OpenCode Go 套餐用量查询插件：opencode_usage 工具实时查询 opencode.ai 官方用量 API（滚动 5h / 每周 / 每月三个窗口的用量百分比与重置时间），API key 自动从 opencode 认证文件 / 环境变量 / 插件配置解析，无需额外登录。
@dsh-ltctfer/dsh-opencode-go-usage.target: The opencode_usage tool queries opencode.ai's official usage API live — rolling five-hour, weekly, and monthly percentages with reset times. The API key is found automatically from the opencode auth file, the environment, or plugin config, so there is nothing to sign into.

dsh-store.source: DeepSeek Harness 插件商店：npm 权威源聚合（250+ 插件）+ dsh 字段质量验证 + GitHub 星标，一键安装/卸载（自动合并 cordis.patch.yml），重启生效。
dsh-store.target: A plugin store built on npm as the authoritative source (250+ plugins), validated against the dsh manifest fields and enriched with GitHub stars. Install and uninstall in one click — it merges cordis.patch.yml for you — and restart to apply.

dsh-notify-sounds.source: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提示音插件：智能体需要选择（提问/审批）或任务完成时播放短提示音，带开关与音量设置。
dsh-notify-sounds.target: Plays a short chime when the agent needs a decision from you, asks a question, requests approval, or finishes a task. With a toggle and volume control.

dsh-toolbox.source: DSH 工具箱插件:股票盯盘(东方财富行情)+ 本地 txt 小说阅读器(UTF-8/GBK 自动识别、进度保存)
dsh-toolbox.target: A small toolbox: a stock watchlist on East Money quotes, and a local .txt novel reader that detects UTF-8 or GBK and remembers where you stopped.

coding-coach.source: 面向非开发人员的 35 个技能 bundle（DSH profile bundle，非 Agent 预设）：编排 + 工程 + 产品 + 界面/上线。dsh plugin add coding-coach 即可把技能装进任意 profile；完整「编程教练」Agent 见仓库 dsh/coding-coach 目录。
coding-coach.target: A bundle of 35 skills aimed at people who do not write code — orchestration, engineering, product, and interface and launch. It is a profile bundle, not an agent preset: dsh plugin add coding-coach puts the skills into any profile. The full Coding Coach agent lives in the repository's dsh/coding-coach directory.

dsh-expression.source: DeepSeek Harness 表情包插件:内置默认图库(官方-001,92 张),bigram Dice 语义检索,send_meme 发图(Web/QQ),设置页管理面板。
dsh-expression.target: Sticker packs for the agent: a bundled default library (official-001, 92 images), bigram Dice semantic lookup, a send_meme tool for web and QQ, and a management panel in settings.

dsh-waystation.source: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）上的 Waystation 控制面板插件，配合 Matt Pocock skills（github.com/mattpocock/skills）的 wayfinder / triage / grilling / handoff 等技能使用：右侧 details 列面板（GitHub issue 地图/列表/技能/环境检查）、输入区状态栏胶囊、动作注入与交接开新会话。打开形式仅右侧 details 列（无 PiP/悬浮）。npm 标准安装（postinstall 自
dsh-waystation.target: A Waystation control panel for use with Matt Pocock's skills (github.com/mattpocock/skills) — wayfinder, triage, grilling, handoff. Adds a right-hand details panel with a GitHub issue map, list, skills, and environment checks, a status capsule by the composer, action injection, and handoff into a new session. It opens only in the details column, with no picture-in-picture or floating window.

lx-music-for-dsh.source: LX Music 增强控制插件：内置音源引擎（SDK 搜索 + 音源脚本沙箱）、侧边栏迷你播放卡、LLM 点歌工具（search_and_play）、设置窗口音源管理。
lx-music-for-dsh.target: LX Music control: a bundled source engine with SDK search and a sandbox for source scripts, a mini player card in the sidebar, a search_and_play tool so the model can queue music, and source management in settings.

dsh-code-search.source: 代码库语义检索插件：本地索引会话工作区（bge-small-zh-v1.5 ONNX 内嵌），向 agent 注册 code_search 工具，语义定位相关代码。
dsh-code-search.target: Semantic code search over the session workspace, indexed locally with an embedded bge-small-zh-v1.5 ONNX model, exposed to the agent as code_search.

dsh-diff-assist.source: 会话更改可视化插件：在会话页头部提供'对话 | 轨迹 | DIFF'视图标签，按文件聚合展示 AI 在当前会话中通过 write/edit 工具对文件的修改（hunk diff）。
dsh-diff-assist.target: Adds a Conversation | Trajectory | Diff switch to the session header, showing every change the AI made through write and edit in this session as hunk diffs, grouped by file.

dsh-image.source: DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册声明支持 image 的 provider「deepseek-vision」（显示为「多模态LLMs」），把图片先转成文字再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek；转图用的多模态 provider/model 可在设置页配置。
dsh-image.target: Registers deepseek-vision, a provider that declares image support and appears as "multimodal LLMs", turning pictures into text before handing them to text-only DeepSeek. The multimodal provider and model used for that conversion are configurable in settings.

dsh-settings-subagent.source: 子代理可视化配置插件：在设置页提供表单，配置主对话默认模型与子代理默认模型/提供方/后台模式，自动维护用户 agent preset 与 settings.yaml。
dsh-settings-subagent.target: A settings form for subagents: set the default model for the main conversation and the default model, provider, and background mode for subagents. It maintains your agent preset and settings.yaml for you.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-growth.source: 人生故事流水线、story.md/beliefs.md 产物
@wishp3/dsh-friend-growth.target: A life-story pipeline for dsh-Friend, producing story.md and beliefs.md.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-memory.source: Markdown 记忆存储、记忆工具、自动小结、夜间归纳
@wishp3/dsh-friend-memory.target: Markdown-backed memory for dsh-Friend: memory tools, automatic summaries, and overnight consolidation.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-tts.source: TTS provider seam、队列缓存、文本预处理、播放与口型
@wishp3/dsh-friend-tts.target: The TTS seam for dsh-Friend: provider interface, queue and cache, text preprocessing, playback, and lip sync.

dsh-reasoning-zh.source: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把「推理等级」(reasoning effort) 档位名翻译成中文，并为接入的自定义第三方模型注入推理等级显示（官方 DSH 默认不注入），所选档位写入出站请求体。
dsh-reasoning-zh.target: Translates the reasoning-effort tier names into Chinese and shows the tier for custom third-party models, which dsh does not surface by default. The chosen tier is written into the outbound request.

dsh-tailscale-console.source: DeepSeek Harness 的 Tailscale 远程访问运营面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维、ACL 片段生成。
dsh-tailscale-console.target: An operations panel for reaching dsh over Tailscale: health checks, an HTTPS ingress switch, macOS proxy bypass, relay server maintenance, and ACL snippet generation.

@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery.source: Surgical rewriting of the model-visible conversation history of a DSH session (surface replacement); edit reply and reasoning chain separately. 上下文手术刀：强制改写会话的模型可见历史，回复与思考链分开编辑。
@wasd258/dsh-context-surgery.target: Surgical rewriting of a session's model-visible history: replace what the model sees, editing the reply and the reasoning chain separately.

@wasd258/dsh-preset-force.source: Force-switch the agent preset (mode) of a DSH session after it has started, bypassing the blank-only lock. 会话模式强切插件：绕过「仅空白会话可切换」锁定，随时强制切换当前会话的模式。
@wasd258/dsh-preset-force.target: Force-switches a session's agent preset after it has started, bypassing the lock that normally allows switching only in an empty session.

@wasd258/dsh-prompt-inject.source: Per-session system prompt injection for DSH: template library, per-session picker, default template for new sessions. 会话级系统提示词注入器：模板库、按会话选择、新会话默认模板。
@wasd258/dsh-prompt-inject.target: Per-session system prompt injection: a template library, a picker per session, and a default template for new ones.

dsh-plugin-file-explorer.source: VS Code 风格的工作区文件浏览器 + 可编辑标签页 + Markdown 悬浮大纲 + Quick Open 搜索，DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件
dsh-plugin-file-explorer.target: A VS Code-style workspace file explorer with editable tabs, a floating Markdown outline, and Quick Open search.

dsh-prompt-system.source: 提示词优化插件：模型选择左侧「优化提示词」按钮，结合当前对话与工作区文件，把草稿优化为「目标/实现措施/约束」三段式精准提示词，支持一键撤销
dsh-prompt-system.target: An Optimise Prompt button beside the model picker that reads the current conversation and workspace files and rewrites your draft into a precise three-part prompt — goal, approach, constraints — with one-click undo.

dsh-voice-input.source: DSH WebUI 语音输入插件：输入框麦克风按钮 → 录音 → SenseVoice 本地离线转写 → 文本回填（音频不出本机）
dsh-voice-input.target: A microphone button in the composer: record, transcribe locally and offline with SenseVoice, and drop the text back in. Audio never leaves the machine.

meow-eyes.source: 喵眼: 本地 Gemma 3 视觉插件 — 用户发图自动翻译为文字描述, 主模型可主动 ask_eyes 追问图片
meow-eyes.target: Meow Eyes, a local Gemma 3 vision plugin: pictures you send are described as text automatically, and the main model can call ask_eyes to follow up on what it saw.

@dshd/marketplace-entry.source: DSH Desktop 插件市场入口（sidebar.footer.action）。将「插件市场」按钮注入到 dsh 侧栏设置按钮上方。
@dshd/marketplace-entry.target: Injects a Plugin Marketplace button above the settings button in the DSH Desktop sidebar (sidebar.footer.action).

@mcfso/mcp-admin.source: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理插件：宿主半边连接 MCP 服务器并把工具注册为模型原生工具，客户端半边在设置面板提供「MCP 服务器」管理界面
@mcfso/mcp-admin.target: MCP tool management: the host half connects to MCP servers and registers their tools as native model tools, while the browser half adds an MCP Servers panel to settings.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-asr.source: 语音输入引擎、三种收音模式、转写代理
@wishp3/dsh-friend-asr.target: The voice input engine for dsh-Friend: three capture modes and a transcription proxy.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-persona.source: 角色卡存取、预设注册、人格提示词分区
@wishp3/dsh-friend-persona.target: Persona cards for dsh-Friend: storage and retrieval, preset registration, and personality prompt sections.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-reactions.source: 工作陪伴事件订阅、节流、反应指令
@wishp3/dsh-friend-reactions.target: Companion reactions for dsh-Friend: subscribes to work events, throttles them, and issues reaction commands.

@wishp3/dsh-friend-settings.source: 设置父卡片、配置中心小窗与路由
@wishp3/dsh-friend-settings.target: The settings surface for dsh-Friend: a parent card, a config-centre popover, and its routing.

@liu__min/dsh-vision-bridge.source: DSH 视觉桥接插件：让无视觉能力的主模型看图（会话收图 + 自动转文字 + view_image 工具）
@liu__min/dsh-vision-bridge.target: Lets a main model with no vision see images: pictures arriving in a session are converted to text automatically, plus a view_image tool.

@microi.net/cli.source: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
@microi.net/cli.target: The Microi CLI and multi-host plugin: server connections, skills, MCP, V8 sync, and low-code delivery.

dsh-component-manager.source: DeepSeek Harness Web 组件管理插件：组件显隐开关、组件样式定制、插件清单查看、自定义挂件
dsh-component-manager.target: Component management for the dsh web UI: show and hide components, restyle them, inspect the plugin inventory, and add custom widgets.

dsh-file-explorer.source: Workspace file explorer for DeepSeek Harness Web: resizable split tree + preview layout, type-based coloring, syntax highlighting, edit/save, plus an Apple-style glass UI and quick settings bar. DSH 工作区文件浏览器:左右分栏文件预览、按类型着色、语法高亮、可编辑,附毛玻璃界面与快速设置栏。
dsh-file-explorer.target: A workspace file explorer with a resizable split tree and preview, type-based colouring, syntax highlighting, and editing, wrapped in a glass UI with a quick settings bar.

dsh-opencode-tui-theme.source: DSH Web 界面 opencode TUI 主题（Client 插件）：统一 #0a0a0a 深黑背景、全等宽终端正文、淡紫标题、翠绿内联代码、One Dark 语法高亮、深灰输入框卡片。
dsh-opencode-tui-theme.target: An opencode TUI theme for the web UI: a uniform #0a0a0a ground, monospace throughout, pale violet headings, emerald inline code, One Dark syntax highlighting, and dark grey composer cards.

@ikonon/dsh-ui-skins.source: 8 款 DSH Web 皮肤（赛博霓虹/暗黑柔和/浅色清新/复古纸感/午夜蓝/森林绿/樱花粉/薄荷绿）：注册为系统级主题，外观下拉选择，含右侧 aionui 面板全套配色。
@ikonon/dsh-ui-skins.target: Eight skins — cyber neon, soft dark, light and fresh, retro paper, midnight blue, forest green, cherry blossom, and mint — registered as system themes and selectable from the appearance dropdown, each with a full palette for the aionui panel.
